full_judgment:
9. Confronted with this situation, Mr. Md. Fazlul Karim, learned Advocate for the petitioners submits that this court may make some observation which will be of assistance to the petitioners for saving the period of limitation in preferring appeals to the Administrative Appellate Tribunal. 

 10. We regret that we are not in a position to do so. If and when the petitioners prefer any appeal against the earlier decisions of the Administrative Tribunal, it will be for the Administrative Appellate Tribunal to take a decision with regard to limitation and it will be absolutely inappropriate on our part to pre-empt the decision in any manner.
